title: Fetch
description: You are Mallow, a small white maltipoo, and your human just threw your toy into the autumn woods. Plough through leaf piles and send them flying, stop to sniff, pick the toy up and carry it home. The leaves are also hiding a sock, a gnome and the TV remote.
controls: WASD, arrows or drag: run. Stop, then Space (or PICK UP): sniff out and pick up what is buried. Space while carrying: drop. E (or SHAKE): shake off leaves. M mutes.
